subject: Urban Planning
title: Boston's Big Dig: The Most Expensive Road Ever
description: Learn Boston's Big Dig: The Most Expensive Road Ever in one minute.

hook.text: Boston buried its central highway underground. It was supposed to cost $2.6 billion. It cost $24.3 billion.

buildup.text: The Big Dig took 15 years, displaced 14,000 residents, and generated enough dirt to fill Gillette Stadium 16 times.

discovery.text: Leaks, falling ceiling panels, and a fatal tunnel collapse plagued the project. One woman died in 2006.

twist.text: Despite the chaos, removing the elevated highway transformed Boston. The Rose Kennedy Greenway now sits above the tunnel.

climax.text: The result was worth it — but the process showed how badly megaprojects can go wrong without oversight.

punchline.text: Budget: $2.6 billion. Final cost: $24.3 billion. Both highway and money: buried.
